description:
Project Overview: An interactive, software-based astronaut health monitoring dashboard designed for space missions.
What It Does:
 * Real-Time Telemetry: Streams simulated vital signs (heart rate, blood pressure, sleep, stress) and spaceflight risks (radiation, fluid shifts).
 * Interactive Visuals: Features a clickable human body interface to inspect specific organ systems and health trends.
 * Smart Alerts: Uses color-coded status badges (Green/Yellow/Red) to flag medical risks and trigger
summary:
AstroGuardian is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring and autonomous medical assistance platform designed to support astronaut safety during long-duration space missions. It integrates continuous health monitoring, anomaly detection, health-risk assessment, and pre-flight versus in-flight baseline comparison to identify unusual physiological changes. Its interactive 3D Digital Twin visualizes affected organs and physiological stress, while a voice-enabled AI medical assistant provides hands-free emergency interaction and medical guidance. The platform also includes health trend visualization, radiation monitoring, mental health tracking, and health activity records.

By combining health telemetry, intelligent analysis, and visual medical assistance, AstroGuardian aims to reduce dependence on immediate Earth-based medical support during communication delays. The current prototype uses simulated telemetry, demonstrating a modular approach that can be extended to real biomedical sensors and advanced predictive models. It aims to make future deep-space missions safer through accessible, astronaut-centered healthcare.
details:
AstroGuardian is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring and autonomous medical assistance platform designed to support astronaut safety during long-duration space missions. It provides a unified dashboard for monitoring physiological health, identifying unusual health patterns, assessing potential risks, and comparing current health parameters against pre-flight baselines.

The platform features an interactive 3D Digital Twin for visualizing organs and physiological stress, a voice-enabled AI medical assistant for emergency interaction, health trend analysis, radiation monitoring, mental health tracking, medication history, and health activity monitoring. It also provides alerts and visual insights to support timely medical assessment.

AstroGuardian addresses critical challenges of space healthcare, including microgravity-induced health changes, radiation exposure, communication delays, isolation, and limited onboard medical facilities. Its intended impact is to improve astronaut health awareness, support early identification of potential health concerns, and reduce dependence on immediate Earth-based assistance.

The technology stack includes React.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Python, FastAPI, Axios, Recharts, Lucide React, and the Web Speech API. The prototype uses simulated health telemetry and a modular architecture.

Our creative approach combines health analytics, 3D visualization, and voice-based medical interaction in a single astronaut-centered platform. We considered usability, accessibility, communication constraints, medical safety, and the unique physiological challenges of deep-space missions while designing the system.
